messages:
zoe: Quick thread to align on a condensed solution brief + two social launches + webinar blurb for our deploy-mode messaging (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Focus: security controls, SLA tiers, and inbound routing.
aj: I'll take the one-pager and one social post. Need concrete SLA/latency lines from eng before finalizing.
marc: Field asks for a single comparison table row: risk surface, SLA tier, recommended buyer profile. Keep it one-line each.
elena: I can write the webinar blurb and the exec-facing LinkedIn post. Please give me a short ops quote about failover guarantees.
ops-bot: Note: Auto-schedule published webinar "Choosing a Deployment Mode for Regulated Apps" on 2026-04-09 09:00 PT. Reg link: https://events.redwood/dep-modes
zoe: Benchmarks: include a short stat: typical mid-size chat workload (50k tokens/day) shows cost wins with batching+KV cache. Need ops confirmation for percentage.
aj: Draft layout for one-pager: 1) Quick summary 2) Mode at-a-glance (3 bullets each) 3) Security & compliance highlights 4) SLA snapshot (3-tier callout) 5) Benchmark pullout 6) Field next-steps + CTA 7) Webinar + FAQ link.
marc: CTA for field should be "Request a Dedicated Eval" to gate capacity and security reviews. Also include "Start a Trial" for smaller teams.
elena: Suggested lead sentence: "Run reliable LLM inference where you need it 14 hosted, reserved, or in your network 14 with enterprise SLAs and control." Slight wording tweak: avoid saying "all models" for SLA claims.
aj: For benchmark copy: "mid-size chat (50k tokens/day) 14 observed up to ~28% unit-cost reduction using smart batching and KV caching." @ops confirm phrasing.
ops-bot: Uploaded: /benchmarks/dep_mode_digest.csv (p95/p99 samples by model/seq). Latest sample suggests 20-30% savings depending on model and prompt shape.
zoe: Good. We'll use conservative "up to 30%" language with a footnote: "Results vary by model, prompt, and sequence length."
elena: Webinar slide request: 1) Deploy-mode decision flow 2) Security checklist 3) SLA excerpt 4) Field intake steps for dedicated evals.
aj: Field intake paragraph: "To request Dedicated Eval: fill form -> security intake -> capacity sizing -> 2-week trial -> post-trial SLA decision". Marc, can you make that 3 lines for the one-pager?
marc: Yep, will condense. Also add expected timeline: 2-6 weeks depending on compliance docs.
elo: small note: include a minimal ops snippet for Dedicated autoscaling example: ```replicas: min=4 max=24 cpu_target=0.7```
zoe: Social post drafts: (1) product-led: short metric + webinar CTA; (2) exec: focus on SLAs & security. Kevin isn't on thread but pls review tone for paid media.
aj: I'll produce the copy and drop in the doc by 09:30 PT tomorrow.
elena: I'll draft webinar blurb and exec post by EOD.
ops-bot: Registered attendees: 8 (auto-update hourly).
zoe: Final: aim to review by tomorrow 10:00 PT. Everyone please react with :thumbsup: when you have copy in.
